fields.title: First Spawn Chance
fields.description: Percent chance (0-1.0) that the first group spawns.

fields.title: First Spawn Count
fields.description: Number of entities spawned when the first roll succeeds.

fields.title: Spawn
fields.description: Array of entity event triggers to fire on each spawned entity.

fields.title: Second Spawn Chance
fields.description: Percent chance (0-1.0) that the second group spawns (rolled independently of the first).

fields.title: Second Spawn Count
fields.description: Number of entities spawned when the second roll succeeds.

fields.title: Spawn Baby
fields.description: If `true`, spawned entities start as babies (where applicable).

fields.title: Spawn Definition
fields.description: Identifier of the entity definition to spawn.

description: Conditionally spawns one or two groups of entities at the impact location and optionally fires events on each spawned entity.
